serverInfo.name: StartupHub.ai
serverInfo.description: Search any AI startup, enrich profiles with AI, find logos, discover & validate emails.

authentication.description: Pass your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Get one at https://www.startuphub.ai/my-account?tab=api

tools.name: search_startups
tools.description: Search the startup database by name, sector, country, or status

tools.name: get_startup
tools.description: Get full profile for a startup by slug

tools.name: search_investors
tools.description: Search VCs, angels, and accelerators

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search founders, executives, board members, and key team members

tools.name: find_logo
tools.description: Find square and horizontal logos for a company

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: Full AI-powered RAG enrichment for a company

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Verify if an email address is valid and deliverable

tools.name: discover_email
tools.description: Find a professional email from name + domain

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: Get available credit pack pricing. Call when a 402 is returned or the user asks to top up. Credits never expire.

tools.name: scan_agent_readiness
tools.description: Scan any public URL against 18 AI-agent-readiness standards (robots.txt, llms.txt, MCP card, API catalog, OAuth discovery, markdown negotiation, Content Signals, x402, etc.). Returns 0-100 score + per-check results with copy-paste fix prompts. Free.

tools.name: submit_startup
tools.description: Submit a new startup profile for inclusion on StartupHub.ai. Submissions enter a moderation queue (not publicly visible until an admin approves). Strict format: third-person prose, no listicle titles, no HTML/markdown. On bad input, returns 400 with field-level errors: { errors: [{ field, message, suggestion }] } so the agent can fix and retry. Costs 5 credits. One profile per company website domain. Optional logo_url is fetched and stored automatically (≤2MB).

name.description: Official company name (≤80 chars; no listicle words like 'best/top/2026')

one_liner.description: One-sentence pitch in third person, 20-200 chars

description.description: Full description in third person, 30-400 words, plain text only

logo_url.description: Optional URL to a company logo (PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG, ≤2MB). Server fetches and stores it; no logo = auto-discover from website later.

tools.name: submit_investor
tools.description: Submit a new investor profile (VC/Angel/Accelerator/etc.) for moderation review. Same rules as submit_startup. Costs 5 credits. Deduped by website domain or name+country. Optional logo_url.

type.description: VC | Angel | Accelerator | Incubator | Corporate VC | Family Office | Sovereign Wealth Fund | Crowdfunding | PE | Hedge Fund | Syndicate

stage_focus.description: Pre-seed | Seed | Series A | Series B | Series C | Series D | Growth | Late Stage

tools.name: submit_product
tools.description: Submit a new product / tool / API / library / agent / model / dataset / hardware. Optional startup_slug links to a parent company; omit if standalone. Strict format: third-person, no HTML, no listicle titles. Optional logo_url and screenshot_urls (up to 6) are fetched and stored automatically. Costs 5 credits.

product_type.description: web-app | mobile-app | desktop-app | api | cli | library | extension | mcp-server | agent | model | platform | dataset | hardware | plugin

pricing_type.description: free | freemium | paid | subscription | one-time | usage-based | enterprise | open-source

tools.name: submit_funding_round
tools.description: Announce a funding round for a startup you own. Strict: series from controlled vocab, USD amount, YYYY-MM-DD date. Optional lead/participating investor slugs. Dedup against same-startup same-series within 7 days. Costs 5 credits.

series.description: Pre-seed | Seed | Pre-Series A | Series A | Series B | ... | Convertible Note | SAFE | Bridge | Debt | Grant | Crowdfunding | Growth | Pre-IPO | Strategic | Secondary | Other

tools.name: submit_exit_event
tools.description: Announce an IPO / Acquisition / Merger / SPAC / Buyout / Closure for a startup you own. acquirer_name required for Acquisition/Merger; stock_exchange + ticker required for IPO/SPAC. Costs 5 credits.

transaction_type.description: IPO | Acquisition | Merger | SPAC | Secondary Sale | Buyout | Management Buyout | Tender Offer | Asset Sale | Bankruptcy | Closure

tools.name: submit_research
tools.description: Submit a research paper / preprint. Optional startup link. Dedup by arxiv_id or doi. Third-person abstract, 30-600 words. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: submit_patent
tools.description: Submit a patent. patent_number required (e.g. US12345678B2). Dedup by patent_number. Costs 5 credits.

status.description: Granted | Pending | Filed | Expired | Withdrawn | Other

tools.name: submit_news
tools.description: Submit a news article / press release. Strict: third-person, controlled categories, 100-10000 words. Dedup by source_url or similar title within 30 days. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: submit_person
tools.description: Submit a new person profile (founder/executive/board member) for moderation review. Requires either current_title or linkedin_url to disambiguate from common-name dupes. Third-person bio, plain text. Costs 5 credits. Optional avatar_url.

current_title.description: e.g. "CEO at OpenAI" — required if no linkedin_url

linkedin_url.description: Personal LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/...) — required if no current_title

tools.name: update_startup
tools.description: Update an existing startup profile you previously submitted (your API-key user must match created_by). Pass slug + only the fields to change. Significant edits (description / one_liner / sectors) re-flag for admin re-review. Costs 1 db credit.

tools.name: update_investor
tools.description: Update an existing investor profile you previously submitted. Pass slug + only the fields to change. Costs 1 db credit.

tools.name: update_person
tools.description: Update an existing person profile you previously submitted. Pass slug + only the fields to change. Costs 1 db credit.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update an existing product profile you previously submitted (e.g. when you ship a new feature, change pricing, or launch a v2). Pass slug + only the fields to change. Significant edits re-flag for admin re-review. Costs 1 db credit.
